name: dtc-checker
description: Onboard diagnostic trouble code reader for GEM using DSI namespace 2 IOC diagnostic data.
author: dspl1236
screens: ToolkitDTC.esd - DTC overview, detail, and control screens
notes: GEM screen module only. Installs ToolkitDTC.esd and relies on existing IOC diagnostic data exposed through DSI namespace 2.
short_description: Onboard diagnostic trouble code reader — view and clear DTCs from the GEM
detail: 3 GEM screens: DTC overview (20 rows), single DTC detail with status flags, and DTC control (clear/test). Uses DSI namespace 2 via IOC. V850 IOC has TP2.0 diagnostic protocol support.
